name: TheoryLab
purpose: AI-readable executable theory graphs with evidence receipts and replayable discovery history

extension.node_contract: Every executable node declares semantic role, typed ports, parameters, executor and provenance.
extension.theory_contract: Every theory declares question, hypothesis, assumptions, node instances, edges, experiments, measurements, attackers and gates.
extension.evidence_contract: Every run may emit a receipt without mutating the theory definition.
extension.history_contract: Every discovery attempt can point to a parent attempt so alternative exploration policies can replay the realized tree.
